Introduction.SourceString: 头脑灵活，看似是个小孩。实际也是个小孩。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Thinks quick, looks like a kid. Is a kid, actually.

Content.SourceString:
总是被说是「伊波恩异象侦探」里看起来最像侦探的那位。埃德嘉没否认，但也没承认。大概因为解释起来真的很麻烦，很麻烦。
毕竟除此之外的头衔还有「伊波恩王牌三人组」、「猎人帮最具潜力新星选手」、「桥间地异象猎人TOP3」以及未来无数个被娜娜莉或早雾塔吉多（有时候还有鬼郎丸）随口编出来的气势响当当外号。

明明还是个满脸稚气的小小少年，行为举止却是超乎他年纪的成熟，甚至可以说，老成。大概是另外两位都是风风火火行动派的缘故，每当娜娜莉和早雾为新发现的线索一溜烟跑远，埃德嘉总是鞠躬向人道谢的那位。更多时候，则是道歉和结账。
当然啦，埃德嘉最主要负责的还是搜集情报和制定行动计划。至于行动计划被严格遵守过几次——哎呀，只要结果是好的，管那么多呢！这套理论，目前埃德嘉已经深以为然。不过并不妨碍他每次的精心准备，并为可能（或者说一定）发生的意外状况准备PLAN B。
塔吉多经常看着三位年轻的异象猎人出门远去的身影，故作高深叹口气「未来的埃德嘉，会成为阿德勒先生！」
Content.LocalizedString:
Of the "Eibon Anomaly Detectives," most say he looks the most befitting of the 'detective' mantle. Edgar neither denies nor confirms this… Probably because explaining it would be really, really troublesome.
After all, his other titles include "Eibon Ace Trio," "Hyelp's Most Promising Rising Star," "Bridge Crossings' Top 3 Anomaly Hunter," and countless other impressive-sounding nicknames that Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo (and sometimes Kiroumaru too) casually make up.

Despite still being a baby-faced boy, he's remarkably mature for his age; almost old-fashioned, likely because the other two are so impulsive that Edgar is always the one left bowing and thanking people. More often than not, he's the one apologizing and paying the bills.
Of course, Edgar's main responsibilities are gathering intel and planning operations. As for how many times those plans have been followed… well, as long as the results are good, who cares? Edgar has come to fully embrace this philosophy; though it doesn't stop him from carefully preparing each time and having a Plan B ready for any unexpected situations that might (or rather, definitely will) occur.
Taygedo often watches the three young Hunters head out and sighs with mock profundity: "Future Edgar will be just like Adler!"

Content.SourceString:
都说遗忘也是成长的一部分。长大后的大人们，大都对儿时只剩下些模模糊糊，像被套上某种柔光滤镜，怎样都看不真切的回忆片段。
埃德嘉却并非如此。只要努力回想，每一天都能在脑海中尽数浮现。
家人得知埃德嘉的异能的那天，是这样的——

寻常，和过去每一天都没什么两样的傍晚，埃德嘉三岁的某一天。下班回家的爸爸妈妈和埃德嘉正享受着餐桌上的亲子时光。清淡可口的菜肴佐以爸爸口述的有趣异象小故事，再惬意不过如此。
埃德嘉的父母都是尤克阿什庭负责撰写维护异象档案的文员，因此爸爸总有讲不完的故事——取材自上班时间编写的，已对公众开放的异象档案，再稍作改编的小故事。
但，现在的埃德嘉还不知道这些。每当爸爸在餐桌上滔滔不绝起来，一低头满眼皆是宝贝儿子亮晶晶的眼神……
被儿子当成「故事大王」崇拜，加多少班都值了。

「奇怪？好像和爸爸写的档案不太一样？到底哪一个才是真的？」
自埃德嘉认真提问的那刻起，有些东西就永远也回不到过去了，埃德嘉爸爸大概会永远记得这个瞬间。不过他的注意力很快聚焦到更为关键的事上：埃德嘉怎么知道他才录入的异象档案？
儿子什么时候翻窗出门一路小跑，跑去尤克阿什庭看档案了？这么小的孩子也有权限查阅档案吗？

接下来的半个小时，爸爸妈妈终于弄清了这是怎么回事：原来埃德嘉只需努力想象（两位大人也努力调动自己的想象力想象这个画面），便能和诸多图书馆建立联系，尤克阿什庭的档案馆也不例外。埃德嘉大概太过好奇爸爸写过什么内容，情不自禁想着爸爸的名字……有埃德嘉爸爸署名的异象档案，就这么一份一份在埃德嘉脑海中摊开来……
顺便一说的是，埃德嘉早就发现自己有这样的能力，大概是天生的吧？只是在更早之前，他还不怎么识字，看不太懂白纸上密密麻麻的东西……

埃德嘉大概已经读过自己刚刚开始工作时，笔触尚还稚嫩的档案——「黑历史」已经在儿子面前一览无余了。想到这里，埃德嘉爸爸决定先溜去厨房洗碗，回头再细细研究儿子的异能。

「这孩子真是随我~我们第一次约会的那天晚上，我也是把你写的论文读了个遍。」
妻子也没放过他。
Content.LocalizedString:
They say forgetting is part of growing up. Most adults only retain hazy fragments of their childhood memories, as if viewing them through some kind of fuzzy filter that makes everything impossible to see clearly.

Edgar is different. With enough effort, he can recall every single day with perfect clarity.

The day Edgar’s family discovered his esper ability went like this:

Edgar was three years old. It was an ordinary evening, no different from any other. His parents had just come home from work, and they were enjoying family time around the dinner table. Light, delicious dishes accompanied by Dad's interesting little anomaly stories made for the perfect cozy atmosphere.

Both of Edgar's parents were clerks at Yggash Court. They were responsible for writing and maintaining anomaly profiles, so Dad always had endless stories to tell. The stories were little tales adapted from the publicly available anomaly profiles he wrote during work hours.

But young Edgar didn't know any of this yet. Whenever Dad got carried away telling stories at the dinner table, he'd look down to see his precious son's bright, sparkling eyes gazing up at him…

Being worshipped by his son as the "Story King" made all those overtime hours worth it.

"That's strange? It seems different from what Dad wrote in the files? Which one is actually true?"

Something changed forever the moment Edgar asked this serious question. Edgar's dad would probably remember that instant for the rest of his life. But his dad quickly focused on something more crucial: how did Edgar know about the anomaly profiles he'd just filed?

Had his son snuck out through the window and run all the way to Yggash Court to read the files? Did such a small child even have clearance to access those documents?

Over the next half hour, Mom and Dad finally figured out what was happening: Edgar only needed to focus his imagination (both adults also had to stretch their own imaginations to picture this) to connect with various libraries around the world, including Yggash Court's archive. Edgar had probably been too curious about what Dad had written, and couldn't help thinking about his father's name… One by one, the anomaly profiles bearing Edgar's father's signature unfolded in Edgar's mind…

By the way, Edgar had discovered this ability long ago. It was probably innate, right? It's just that earlier on, he couldn't read very well, so he couldn't understand all those dense markings on the white papers…

Edgar had probably already read through his father's early work files, when his writing style was still immature. His dad’s "dark history" was now completely exposed to his son. With this realization, Edgar's dad decided to escape to the kitchen to wash dishes, planning to study his son's esper ability more carefully later.

"This child really takes after me. On the night of our first date, I also read through all your papers from cover to cover."

His wife wouldn’t let him off the hook either.

Title.LocalizedString: What does Edgar want to be?

Content.SourceString:
天才儿童、传闻中「邻居家的孩子」、「被智慧之神亲吻的少年」。

埃德嘉从「灯校」毕业回家的那天，携自家孩子蜂拥来祝贺的七大姑八大姨街坊邻居们，险些把埃德嘉家的门坎踢平。只是好奇来看看所谓的「你要以人家为榜样的邻居家孩子」究竟有何不一样，又或是满不情愿嘟着嘴被家长要求「多学学人家」的小孩们，得出同样的结论——
看起来真没什么特别的。

而此刻被大人们团团包围住的埃德嘉，已经晕头转向，飞速转动的脑瓜怎么都追不上他们七嘴八舌的跨度。唾沫横飞间，埃德嘉的未来蓝图渐渐清晰：埃德嘉马上就当上「零角实验室」金牌研究员、「尤克阿什庭」的明日之星、「异象管理局」的新任局长。粉爪银行的offer也可以考虑考虑，以埃德嘉的能力出任粉爪银行的董事又有何难？当然，到时候别忘了提携提携住他斜对门那个每门成绩都在及格线上下徘徊的臭小子……

那些罗列着，为他安排诸多光明前程的大人们，彻底沉浸在自己的想象里了。就好像埃德嘉才是他们亲生小孩，一个接一个地替他们实现所有无法亲自达成，只能寄托在后代上的梦想。

埃德嘉左看看右看看，谁的话茬都接不上。紧张到把围巾拉得高高的，恨不得整个人都能躲进去。好在爸爸此时也挤了过来，拍拍他的肩头：埃德嘉以后想当什么？

在爸爸目光的鼓励下，埃德嘉轻声道：
我……我只想当「埃德嘉」。
Content.LocalizedString:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Lamplight Academy, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."

Title.LocalizedString: The World Beyond the Tree Hollow

Content.SourceString:
论点一：埃德嘉非常喜欢异象
论点二：埃德嘉的脑瓜还算灵活
论点三：埃德嘉访问异象档案很方便

所以，埃德嘉很适合像爸爸妈妈一样，在尤克阿什庭的档案馆工作，整理文书，无止尽地学习异象相关的知识。

儿子的这番推论，让埃德嘉妈妈费了很大功夫才忍住笑。并非结论荒谬可笑——或者说恰恰相反，逻辑清晰推导合理，简直让人没有拒绝的道理。
但现在让埃德嘉也住进尤克阿什庭的树洞，戴起厚厚的啤酒瓶底眼镜，窝在厚厚文件袋里还太早了些。妈妈不是不明白儿子的心愿，但比起从其他人的报告中了解异象，埃德嘉亲眼去见识、亲自去验证那些奇妙的点点滴滴，不是更好吗？谁知道下一个街角会遇到什么异象？还有多少未知的异象特性有待我们的发现？
埃德嘉听得很认真。

埃德嘉大约也继承了来自妈妈的冒险精神，看起来颇有些胡闹的约定就这么拉钩约好了：妈妈拉着埃德嘉的手，蒙着眼睛把飞镖钉向地图。所谓的运气，或者说命运，亦可以是缘分，决定了埃德嘉的这场冒险——离开学校后的第一场冒险的目的地，海特洛市。

永远好奇，永远想求知，永远勇于尝试。
Content.LocalizedString:
- Point One: Edgar really likes Anomalies
- Point Two: Edgar's mind is reasonably sharp
- Point Three: Edgar can easily access Anomaly profiles

Therefore, Edgar is well-suited to work at Yggash Court's archives like his parents, organizing documents and studying Anomaly-related topics until the day he dies.

Edgar's mother had to work very hard to suppress her laughter at her son's reasoning; not because the conclusion was absurd or ridiculous—quite the opposite, actually. The logic was clear and the reasoning sound, leaving almost no room for refusal.
But having Edgar move into Yggash Court's tree hollow, put on thick beer-bottle glasses, and bury himself in stacks of files was still a bit… premature. Mom understood her son's wishes, but… Wouldn't it be better for Edgar to personally verify those details, rather than learning about Anomalies from other people's reports? Who knew what Anomalies might be waiting around the next corner? How many unknown Anomaly characteristics were still waiting for us to discover them?
Edgar listened very seriously.

He'd probably inherited his mother's adventurous spirit too. What seemed like a rather silly promise was sealed with a pinky promise. Mom took Edgar's hand and, blindfolded, threw a dart at a map. Luck—or perhaps fate—decided Edgar's adventure: his first journey after graduation would take him to Hethereau.

Forever curious, forever seeking knowledge, forever willing to try.

Content.SourceString:
站在熙熙攘攘街角的埃德嘉并不知道自己要去哪里。他想了很久，很久，依旧迷茫又困惑。
放弃了路线规划，地图，导航。他按照妈妈的说法，正在海特洛市「随心所欲漫游」，据说与缘分的邂逅，往往是在不经意间降临的。
没有目的地，也不知道要往哪个方向走，这样就能找到「缘分」吗？埃德嘉完全无法想象毫无规划的行动方式，因而迟迟也迈不开接下来的脚步。他索性在街边小摊买上一小包饲料，蹲在喷泉前喂起鸽子来。

后来，每当埃德嘉回想那一天，都觉得自己模模糊糊懂了些妈妈口中的「命中注定」。
就在他感受着白鸽在掌心啄来啄去的痒意，看着天边渐渐泛起暖橙色，烫金的云朵向尚且蔚蓝的地方驶去的时候，一阵不知从何而来的风猛一下拍到他脸上。与之一起来的还有张字迹歪歪扭扭，画着某电视头生物的招聘海报。

「伊波恩古董店」。
他起身四处看了看，向路标指示的半角街走去。
Content.LocalizedString:
Standing on the bustling street corner, Edgar had no idea where he was supposed to go. Though he thought for a long, long time, he remained just as lost, just as confused.
He gave up on route planning, maps, and navigation. Following his mother's advice, he was now "letting the wind guide him" through Hethereau. According to her, encounters with destiny often arrive when you least expect them.
With no destination and no clue which direction to take, could he really find his "destiny" this way? Edgar couldn't fathom such an unplanned approach; the indecision paralyzed him. Instead, he bought a small bag of feed from a street vendor and crouched by the fountain to feed the pigeons.

Later, when Edgar looked back on that day, he felt he'd begun to dimly understand what his mother meant by "fate."
As he felt the pigeons pecking at his palm, watching the sky gradually turn a warm orange as golden clouds drifted toward the still-blue horizon, a sudden gust of wind smacked him right in the face. Along with it came a recruitment poster with crooked handwriting and a drawing of some TV-headed creature.

"Eibon Antique Shop."
He stood up, looked around, and followed the street signs to Hankaku Street.

Content.SourceString:
语言不通，但弄懂塔吉多的意思并不难。
结合「塔吉塔吉」的语调和频率、塔吉多此刻显示的表情，还有他丰富的肢体动作，埃德嘉读懂了：
「欢迎！新朋友！」

异象观察日记正式开始新的一页，观察对象自然是奇妙的电视机头海獭。当然，埃德嘉的观察记录并不像爸爸妈妈的那么正式，他写下的只是塔吉多的小习惯，小怪癖，獭生目标……以及许许多多与塔吉多一起生活的日常。
这本整洁漂亮的笔记本，消耗得远比埃德嘉想象中要快得多。可能是因为从中间的某页起，一整页被贴满塔吉多的自拍照，还附赠塔吉多的爪印一枚。某页被荧光粉马克笔狠狠批注：「好哇塔吉多！果然是你偷吃了我的布丁！」还有连续的好几页有可疑的水渍（最好不要细想是究竟是什么液体），就紧跟在「要不要也写写看鬼郎丸？我已经替这家伙同意了。」之后。

诚然，埃德嘉不太擅长表达自己。但心意相通并不一定要通过语言……埃德嘉和娜娜莉、早雾还有塔吉多一起躺在屋顶看星星时，他没由头想到。

不过语言可以加速这一历程——某次和塔吉多比划半天仍大眼瞪小眼后，埃德嘉在心中补充道。
Content.LocalizedString:
They didn't share a language, but understanding Taygedo wasn't too difficult.
By combining the tone and frequency of Taygedo's "Tayge-tayge" sounds with his expressions and gestures, Edgar deciphered:
"Welcome, new friend!"

He began a new chapter in his Anomaly observation diary; it naturally featured the wonderful TV-headed otter. Of course, Edgar's observation records weren't as formal as his parents'; he simply wrote down Taygedo's little habits, quirks, goals… and the many everyday activities with him.
Still, this neat and tidy notebook ran out of space way sooner than Edgar had expected. An entire page was quickly covered with Taygedo's selfies, complete with a bonus paw print. One page had angry highlighter annotations: "So it WAS you, Taygedo! I knew you stole my pudding!" And several consecutive pages had suspicious water stains (best not to think too hard about what liquid that might be), right after the entry: "Should I write about Kiroumaru too? I already agreed on his behalf."

Admittedly, Edgar wasn't very good at expressing himself, but understanding each other didn't necessarily require words, Edgar realized as he lay on the rooftop while stargazing with Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo.

…Though language could speed up the process, Edgar added, after ages spent gesturing with Taygedo—that always ended in confusion.

Content.SourceString: 你好，我是伊波恩古董店的店员埃德嘉。店里接到委托的时候，也会作为见习异象猎人和大家一起行动。
Content.LocalizedString: Greetings, I'm Edgar, staff member of the Eibon Antique Shop. When there are commissions, I also work with others as an apprentice anomaly hunter.

Content.SourceString: 这条围巾是妈妈亲手织的，又轻又暖和。天气热的时候怎么办？会换上爸爸送的丝巾，同样款式的。
Content.LocalizedString: My mother hand-knitted this scarf. It's light and warm. What do I wear when it gets hot? I switch to a silk one I got from my father. It has the same pattern.

Content.SourceString: 要是能更轻点就好了。这算不算知识的重量？
Content.LocalizedString: I wish it could be lighter. Is this what they call the weight of knowledge?

Content.SourceString: 喜欢异象，想知道更多和异象有关的事情，我加入了伊波恩。首先，可以近距离观察塔吉多……
Content.LocalizedString: I like anomalies. I joined Eibon because I wanted to learn more about them. First, I can observe Taygedo up close…

Content.SourceString: 把盆栽搬到院子里晒晒太阳吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's move the plant to the yard for some sunlight.

Content.SourceString: 刚刚看到塔吉多没打伞就跑出去，会不会进水啊……？
Content.LocalizedString: I just saw Taygedo run out without an umbrella. Is he waterproof…?
I won't get cold with my scarf.
I wanna live in a fridge.

Content.SourceString: 早上好。今天有什么安排？要一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Morning. What are your plans for today? Can I tag along?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多有午睡的习惯，现在应该裹着被子睡得正香呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo likes to take siestas. He's probably tucked up cozy somewhere.

Content.SourceString: 充实的一天，今天也很有收获。
Content.LocalizedString: Another productive day. I learned a lot.

Content.SourceString: 小时候，妈妈给我讲过「云朵绵羊」的故事。云朵绵羊会在小孩子入睡后来到他的枕边，把枕头变得像云朵一样蓬松又柔软，让他今晚也能睡得又香又沉。不过，云朵绵羊喜欢早睡，如果你熬夜太晚的话，云朵绵羊可能已经在月亮上睡得很熟了。祝你今晚也能遇到它，晚安，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: When I was little, my mother told me the story of the Cloud Sheep. When a child falls asleep, Cloud Sheep fluff up the pillow to make them sleep through the night. However, Cloud Sheep sleep early, so if you stay up too late, they might already be sleeping on the moon. I hope you meet them tonight though. Good night, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 最近的话，视力有些困扰……娜娜莉说我继续在光线不太好的地方看书的话，她就要把眼镜给我戴了。
Content.LocalizedString: I've been having troubles with my eyesight. Nanally said if I keep reading in dim lights, I'll end up with glasses like her…

Content.SourceString: 说起来，薯条兽会不会是海鸥最喜欢的异象？
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, are Frizzles the favorite anomaly of seagulls?

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达自己也会有类似「今天想吃到很多很多硬币」这样的愿望吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does Nacupeda have wishes like "I want to eat lots and lots of coins today"?

Content.SourceString: 总是在遗忘，所以总是在好奇……？唔……
团三郎会幻化成人类的模样偷抢东西。不过识破它们的伪装并不难：即使幻化成人类，它们仍系着标志性的红色餐巾。鉴定师看店的时候如果遇到类似的「人」，不妨多留意一些。
Content.LocalizedString: Danzaburou can shapeshift into human form to steal things. Their disguise isn't difficult to see through though: even when they transform into humans, they still wear their signature red napkins. When you're shopkeeping, pay extra attention to customers like that.

Content.SourceString: 听说鼠鼠们和一个叫「通行正义」的异象关系很好，似乎是把那个像红绿灯丛林一样的异象当作自己的家了。它们会在那里怎么训练，怎么生活，怎么休息？要是能亲眼见到就好了……唔，虽说如此，几乎没人目睹过「通行正义」的样子。它会不会其实只是个都市传说……？
Content.LocalizedString: I heard the Whiskers are on good terms with an anomaly called the "Justice Executioner," which looks like a jungle of traffic lights. The Whiskers are even using the anomaly as a base. How do they even train and rest there? I hope I could see for myself… Hmm, actually, almost no one has ever seen what the Justice Executioner looks like. Could it be an urban legend…?

Content.SourceString: 不是什么很了不起的能力，但店长说「万万不能让那群送快递的骗去了」、娜娜莉也说「柯林斯家族缺不了这个！」。唔，能帮上大家的忙就好。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not some extraordinary ability, but Hotori said "Don't get poached by those delivery guys." Nanally also told me "The Colucci family can't do without you!" Well, I'm just happy to help.

Content.SourceString: 想像阿德勒先生那样做事井井有条、滴水不漏。我要学的还有很多很多。
Content.LocalizedString: I want to be as organized and meticulous as Adler. I still have so much to learn.

Content.SourceString: 店长总说淘古董最看重的是「眼缘」。眼缘是什么？书里也没有说得很明白……会不会是店长鉴定古董的眼力和经验的合称？
Content.LocalizedString: Hotori always says that salvaging antiques is about having a good eye. But what does that mean? No books explain this very well… Or is that just the experience of looking into antiques?

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸，有点重……早雾力气很大呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru is rather heavy… Sakiri must be very strong.

Content.SourceString: 其实，很想去鬼郎丸的肚子里看一看。虽说鬼郎丸已经同意了，但早雾怎么都不允许的样子……
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, I've been wanting to peek into Kiroumaru's stomach. Kiroumaru agreed, but Sakiri doesn't want me to do it…

Content.SourceString: 老大曾说要开会讨论《家族管理学》。阅读笔记我已经整理好了一部分，但她好像一直没时间……
Content.LocalizedString: The boss once said that we should hold a meeting to discuss a book called "Family Management." I've already prepared some notes, but she never has time…

Content.SourceString: 和达芙蒂尔小姐在一起的时候，哪怕彼此间相对无话，也不会觉得气氛尴尬。或者说……其实我们都挺喜欢这种安静舒心的感觉？
Content.LocalizedString: When I'm with Daffodill, even if we don't talk much, it's never awkward. Maybe… we both enjoy the peace and quiet?

Content.SourceString: 当时就是因为看到了塔吉多手绘的招聘海报，我才决心要来店里应聘的。我在海特洛认识的第一位朋友，就是塔吉多。
Content.LocalizedString: I decided to apply after I saw Taygedo's hand-drawn recruiting flyer. Taygedo was my first friend in Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 第二个家，大家都像家人一样亲切呢。
Content.LocalizedString: It's like a second home. Everyone is close like family.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师难道有读心的异能吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, does your Esper Ability include mindreading?

Content.SourceString: 我很喜欢这个。谢谢你为我这么费心。
Content.LocalizedString: I like it a lot. Thanks for all the effort!

Content.SourceString: 希望你能找到合适的去处。
Content.LocalizedString: Hope you find a good place to go.

Content.SourceString: 下次会找到收容的办法……
Content.LocalizedString: Must find a way to contain the next time…
We'll see each other again… right?
Hotori is going to like this.

Content.SourceString: 可以当作柯林斯家族资金？
这下阿德勒先生能省心不少。

Content.LocalizedString: There's still much I don't know…
Is this all I can do?

Content.SourceString: 要执行家族作战计划吗？
让鬼郎丸消消食吧，早雾。
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri, let Kiroumaru digest his food.
Hotori, I won't let you down.

Content.SourceString: 从阿德勒先生那里学到了很多。
Content.LocalizedString: Adler, I still have much to learn from you.

Content.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔小姐教的技巧……实际用用看吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Daffodill, I'll try to do as you taught.

Content.SourceString: 早雾，现在不是逞强的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri, this isn't the time to act tough.
